name: Leyza B. Florin
tagline: Top rated Bankruptcy attorney in Miami, Florida
education: University of Miami School of Law
about: Leyza B. Florin is an attorney providing legal services covering Bankruptcy: Business and Business Litigation.

Leyza Florin, who practices law in Miami, Florida, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2010 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of Miami School of Law. She graduated in 1996. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1997.
